shortDescription: Create, update or destroy reverse_proxy auth_profile entry in Sophos UTM

options.name: aaa
options.description: List of references to utm_aaa objects (allowed users or groups).

options.name: backend_mode
options.description: Specifies if the backend server needs authentication ([Basic|None]).

options.name: backend_strip_basic_auth
options.description: Should the login data be stripped when proxying the request to the backend host.

options.name: backend_user_prefix
options.description: Prefix string to prepend to the username for backend authentication.

options.name: backend_user_suffix
options.description: Suffix string to append to the username for backend authentication.

options.name: basic_prompt
options.description: The message in the basic authentication prompt.

options.name: comment
options.description: Optional comment string.

options.name: frontend_cookie
options.description: Frontend cookie name.

options.name: frontend_cookie_secret
options.description: Frontend cookie secret.

options.name: frontend_form
options.description: Frontend authentication form name.

options.name: frontend_form_template
options.description: Frontend authentication form template.

options.name: frontend_login
options.description: Frontend login name.

options.name: frontend_logout
options.description: Frontend logout name.

options.name: frontend_mode
options.description: Frontend authentication mode (Form|Basic).

options.name: frontend_realm
options.description: Frontend authentication realm.

options.name: frontend_session_allow_persistency
options.description: Allow session persistency.

options.name: frontend_session_lifetime
options.description: Session lifetime.

options.name: frontend_session_lifetime_limited
options.description: Specifies if limitation of session lifetime is active.

options.name: frontend_session_lifetime_scope
options.description: Scope for frontend_session_lifetime (days|hours|minutes).

options.name: frontend_session_timeout
options.description: Session timeout.

options.name: frontend_session_timeout_enabled
options.description: Specifies if session timeout is active.

options.name: frontend_session_timeout_scope
options.description: Scope for frontend_session_timeout (days|hours|minutes).

options.name: headers
options.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules.

options.name: logout_delegation_urls
options.description: List of logout URLs that logouts are delegated to.

options.name: logout_mode
options.description: Mode of logout (None|Delegation).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

options.name: redirect_to_requested_url
options.description: Should a redirect to the requested URL be made.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the object. V(present) creates or updates an object. V(absent) deletes an object if present.

options.name: utm_host
options.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

options.name: utm_port
options.description: The port of the REST interface.

options.name: utm_protocol
options.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint.

options.name: utm_token
options.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See U(https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en), Chapter 2.4.2.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether the REST interface's SSL certificate should be verified or not.
